overview_description.description:
Droobi is a digital therapeutic product that combines proven behavioral science technique, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and personalized support to help people build healthier habits to reduce the risk factors for developing chronic diseases.  
Droobi Health designs bilingual (Arabic & English) digital health solutions for prevention and management of chronic diseases prevalent in MENA region. With a focus on conditions that primarily rely on behavioral modifications such as diabetes and obesity.

about_short_description.short_description: A digital behavioral  company  to  empowering people with chronic conditions through healthier lifestyle

product.name: Droobi for Diabetes
product.description: A program designed to help users manage their diabetes through AI-enabled platforms and healthcare team support, including blood sugar monitoring and personalized advice.

product.name: Droobi for Prevention
product.description: Focuses on preventing Type 2 diabetes through lifestyle changes, offering expert coaching, tracking tools, and personalized advice to build healthy routines.

product.name: Droobi for Gestational Diabetes
product.description: A program aimed at managing gestational diabetes by empowering users to control their diet and blood glucose levels for a healthier pregnancy.

product.name: Droobi for Hypertension
product.description: Provides specialized support for improving cardiovascular health through blood pressure monitoring, nutrition advice, and physical activity recommendations.

product.name: Droobi for Weight Management
product.description: Supports sustainable weight loss and management through personalized meal plans, real-time feedback, and guidance on daily intake and portion sizes.

product.name: Droobi for Employers
product.description: Offers a health program for employees, aiming to reduce healthcare costs and improve wellness through personalized plans and real-time coaching.
